item.title: Warner Music Group signs new $1.645bn credit agreement with JPMorgan, refinancing existing debt
item.description: Agreement comprises a $1.295B term loan, the proceeds of which will be used to pay off WMG's existing term loan debt and related fees, and a $350M revolving credit facility Source

item.title: Chance the Rapper vs. Pat the Manager trial: Seven revelations from the courtroom so far
item.description: The civil trial between Chancelor Bennett (Chance the Rapper) and his former manager Patrick Corcoran is underway Source

item.title: BMG acquires publishing and recording catalog of UK new wave band A Flock of Seagulls
item.description: The deal covers the ownership of US publishing rights and a participation in publishing income of the band’s catalog globally. Source

item.title: Zebralution folds into Bookwire after acquisition by Insight from GEMA
item.description: The deal arrives less than two months after GEMA sold Zebralution to New York-based private equity firm Insight Holdings Group. Source

item.title: Venu secures $86M in oversubscribed public offering, CEO says: ‘We just raised a ton of money.’
item.description: Venu's portfolio includes Ford Amphitheater, Sunset Amphitheaters, Phil Long Music Hall, and more Source

item.title: Future Islands sign exclusive global deal with Universal Music Publishing
item.description: The signing comes as the band’s 2024 debut album People Who Aren’t There Anymore debuted in the UK Top 10. Source

item.title: Concord acquires UK-based indie label Ninja Tune Records
item.description: The deal brings Ninja Tune’s recorded music operations and its publishing arm, Just Isn’t Music, under Concord’s umbrella. Source

item.description: The acquisition gives Slipstream direct sales operation in Latin America, where Maegatrax has maintained sales staff and regional client relationships. Source
